章节.導入予定車両:
E927形電車
E926形の後継として2029年度に導入を予定する、事業用の新幹線電車（検測車）。愛称は「SOAR」（ソアー）。従来目視で行っていた検査をカメラとAIを活用したものに切り替えるなど、作業の省力化を図る。
E10系電車
東北新幹線に導入予定の新幹線電車。2027年秋以降に走行試験を行い、2030年度の営業運転開始を目指す。
10両編成で、「はこビュン」など荷物輸送に対応した設備を設ける。また「『TRAIN DESK』を発展させたサービス」として、座席間のパーテーション設置や背面テーブルの大型化などを実施した2+2配列の座席を新設する。
外装デザインはイギリスのtangerineが担当しており、濃緑色（イブニングエルム）をベースに明るい緑色（津軽グリーン）を帯として配したものとなる。
安全面では、地震時に列車の揺れを抑えるダンパーを取り付けるとともに、制動距離はE5系よりも15%短くする。検測装置も搭載し、営業列車を走らせながら軌道の状況データを収集する。
なお、同型車両がインドでも導入される予定である。
形式未定（秋田新幹線用）
前述したE927形のベースとなる車両として、E6系の後継となる秋田新幹線用の新型車両を開発していることが公表されている。2025年10月時点で形式名は未発表。

章节.導入予定車両:
E927 series electric car
A departmental Shinkansen electric car (inspection car) planned for introduction in fiscal 2029 as the successor to the E926 type. Its nickname is "SOAR". It aims to save labor by, for example, switching inspections conventionally performed visually to those using cameras and AI.
E10 series electric car
A Shinkansen electric car planned for introduction on the Tōhoku Shinkansen. It will undergo running tests from autumn 2027 onward, with the aim of starting revenue service in fiscal 2030.
It will be a 10-car formation and will be equipped with facilities supporting freight transport such as "Hako Byun". In addition, as a "service developed from 'TRAIN DESK'", it will introduce newly designed 2+2 seating with partitions between seats and larger seat-back tables.
The exterior design is handled by the British firm tangerine, and will be based on a dark green (Evening Elm) with a bright green (Tsugaru Green) band.
In terms of safety, it will be fitted with dampers that suppress train sway during earthquakes, and its braking distance will be 15% shorter than that of the E5 series. It will also carry inspection equipment and collect track-condition data while running as a revenue train.
The same type of vehicle is also planned to be introduced in India.
Type undecided (for the Akita Shinkansen)
It has been announced that a new vehicle for the Akita Shinkansen, which will succeed the E6 series, is being developed as the base vehicle for the aforementioned E927 type. As of October 2025, the type name has not been announced.

E10 series electric car
A Shinkansen electric car planned for introduction on the Tōhoku Shinkansen. It will undergo running tests from autumn 2027 onward, with the aim of starting revenue service in fiscal 2030.
It will be a 10-car formation and will be equipped with facilities supporting freight transport such as "Hako Byun". In addition, as a "service developed from 'TRAIN DESK'", it will introduce newly designed 2+2 seating with partitions between seats and larger seat-back tables.
The exterior design is handled by the British firm tangerine, and will be based on a dark green (Evening Elm) with a bright green (Tsugaru Green) band.
In terms of safety, it will be fitted with dampers that suppress train sway during earthquakes, and its braking distance will be 15% shorter than that of the E5 series. It will also carry inspection equipment and collect track-condition data while running as a revenue train.
The same type of vehicle is also planned to be introduced in India.
Type undecided (for the Akita Shinkansen)
It has been announced that a new vehicle for the Akita Shinkansen, which will succeed the E6 series, is being developed as the base vehicle for the aforementioned E927 type. As of October 2025, the type name has not been announced.
